panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 11 | Sampling-centre and motion contributions to moisture contrasts. All contrasts are temporary minus final departure in 200–800 km annuli. a,b, The pre-event 700-hPa budget and its next-day integral. Horizontal advection, vertical advection and residual sum to the moving tendency on common native-cell and event/centre-lag support. c, Fixed-frame tendency and translation sum to the moving tendency. d, Fixed-centre horizontal advection using actual translation  or the nonzero departure velocity . e, Integrated 850-hPa moisture-flux convergence () before and after departure, using absolute wind and complete support across both windows on its own pressure surface. f, Upper-layer (200–500 hPa) and lower-layer (500–850 hPa) shear contrasts under the three centre choices in Supplementary Fig. 10. Pre-means require three of −24/−18/−12/−6 h; changes use 0 and +24 h; integrals use all five six-hour observations with trapezoidal weights. Samples are n=116 before and n=105 after for the budget, n=105–117 in d, n=101 in e, and n=116–117 before and n=105 for changes in f. Whiskers and shading are pointwise 95% intervals from 2,000 paired-cyclone resamples. The shear intervals and counts are tabulated in Table S5f. The mixed-centre post-event budget equals the along-track budget by definition.

Horizontal advection, vertical advection and residual sum to the moving tendency on common native-cell and event/centre-lag support. c, Fixed-frame tendency and translation sum to the moving tendency. d, Fixed-centre horizontal advection using actual translation  or the nonzero departure velocity . e, Integrated 850-hPa moisture-flux convergence () before and after departure, using absolute wind and complete support across both windows on its own pressure surface. f, Upper-layer (200–500 hPa) and lower-layer (500–850 hPa) shear contrasts under the three centre choices in Supplementary Fig. 10. Pre-means require three of −24/−18/−12/−6 h; changes use 0 and +24 h; integrals use all five six-hour observations with trapezoidal weights. Samples are n=116 before and n=105 after for the budget, n=105–117 in d, n=101 in e, and n=116–117 before and n=105 for changes in f. Whiskers and shading are pointwise 95% intervals from 2,000 paired-cyclone resamples. The shear intervals and counts are tabulated in Table S5f. The mixed-centre post-event budget equals the along-track budget by definition.
